def test_jobs_drawn_at_run_time():
        """Jobs drawn from fixed seeds with fresh figures and dates, graded against the verifier's copy of the model."""
        jobs = {seed: _draw_job(random.Random(seed)) for seed in DRAW_SEEDS}
        assert {len(job["rates"]) for job in jobs.values()} >= {1, 40}
        assert any(r["from"] == "2016-01-02" for job in jobs.values() for r in job["rates"])
        for number, (seed, job) in enumerate(jobs.items()):
            within_limits(job)
            assert not trap_inputs(job), f"drawn job {number} carries {trap_inputs(job)}"
            assert len({p for p, c in job["claims"][0]["wages"] if c >= WEEKS_PAY}) > 52
>           compare(run(job), manual_model.statements(job), f"drawn job {number} (seed {seed})")
